name: [R29] Application process (Java/Tomcat) opens outbound LDAP/RMI connection (possible JNDI injection RCE)
message:
Classic JNDI-injection RCE pattern (Log4Shell-class, CVE-2021-44228 and the general family): a server-side process opens an outbound LDAP (389/636) or RMI (1099) connection, typically right after handling an inbound request. Standalone JNDI exploitation toolkits for this were found, alongside Claude Code/DeepSeek/GLM/Grok model-routing config and 19 custom agent skills, on infrastructure Hunt.io (2026-11-04) tied to a campaign against seven South Korean banks using the ARTEX autonomous-pentest agent (see ../artex-analysis.ja.md -- ARTEX's exact role in that campaign remains unconfirmed). This rule detects the RCE technique itself.

Tune: allowlist your organization's real LDAP/AD and JMX/RMI server hostnames before relying on this.
